subject: Quick question about your booking setup
text: I hope this finds you well. I am thinking about updating the way I take client requests through my site, and I remembered you mentioned using a service that can handle forms, attachments, and automatic responses. Before I spend time comparing providers, could you tell me whether your current setup would still suit a small freelance practice? My concern is fairly specific. I have a contact form that occasionally sends the same request twice if the visitor waits too long on the page. It is not a constant problem, but it creates needless confusion when a client asks why the message appears under two different dates. I want a system that can confirm receipt, prevent duplicate submissions, and store short project notes without requiring much maintenance. If possible, I would also appreciate knowing whether the monthly price changes if the volume grows from a few requests each week to perhaps twenty or thirty. I do not need anything elaborate, just something reliable enough for occasional files and short follow-up emails. If you have five minutes this week, let me know which features proved useful, which ones you skipped, and whether the provider’s support team ever resolved a similar technical bug for you. A practical note about setup time would also help, since I want to avoid changing everything at once during a busy month and without creating extra follow-up work for you.
